about: [C11 after the critic] the river road on foot by the wreck, the views a player gets on stepping out: from the seat, just out (facing his window), turned to the nearest quay lamp, at his back looking at his car, and back along the road. For the tone counts (white / mid).

steps.eval: JSON.stringify({ mode: G.controller.mode, p: [+G.controller.pos.x.toFixed(2), +G.controller.pos.z.toFixed(2), +G.controller.yaw.toFixed(2), +G.controller.pitch.toFixed(2)], phase: G.scenes.ctx.flags.chase && G.scenes.ctx.flags.chase.phase })

steps.look: (() => { const K = G.controller; const tx = (() => { const e = G.camera.position; let b = null, bd = 1e9; for (const l of G.stage.lamps.posts) { if (!l.overWater) continue; const d = Math.hypot(l.post.x - e.x, l.post.z - e.z); if (d < bd) { bd = d; b = l; } } return b; })().post.x, tz = (() => { const e = G.camera.position; let b = null, bd = 1e9; for (const l of G.stage.lamps.posts) { if (!l.overWater) continue; const d = Math.hypot(l.post.x - e.x, l.post.z - e.z); if (d < bd) { bd = d; b = l; } } return b; })().post.z, ty = 1.6; const want = Math.atan2(-(tx - K.pos.x), -(tz - K.pos.z)); const dy = Math.atan2(Math.sin(want - K.yaw), Math.cos(want - K.yaw)); const d = Math.hypot(tx - K.pos.x, tz - K.pos.z); const pit = Math.atan2(ty - G.camera.position.y, d); return [Math.round(-dy / K.sensitivity), Math.round((K.pitch - pit) / K.sensitivity)]; })()
